checks.title: Debug-events query adds no per-row goroutine/allocations under a request context
checks.rationale: 1.14.51 'Avoid per-row goroutines for query cancellation': before, SQLiteRows.Next spawned a goroutine + channel per row whenever ctx.Done() != nil. events_db.QueryEvents (dev-server /dev events API) iterates rows with the HTTP request context.

checks.title: Dev-server DB: reopen/migrations, json_each pruning, backup round trip
checks.rationale: Driver internals changed widely (bind paths, statement cache, handle map, SQLite 3.49 -> 3.53). db.NewSqlite re-runs migrations relying on the 'duplicate column name' error text; UpdateProject prunes overrides via json_each; backup uses the driver's Backup API.
